BiblicalUsage: Zaphnath-paaneah is the Egyptian name Pharaoh gave to Joseph when he set him over Egypt. In Genesis 41:45, Pharaoh called Joseph's name Zaphnath-paaneah.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Zaphnath-paaneah matters because God works through ordinary people, and no name in His book is there by accident.
